title: Wave Scrub
description: A precision scrubber over a song's waveform, set large and in ink. Hover to preview the jump with the time and section beneath your pointer, press to zoom the waveform around your finger and drag at a fraction of the speed; release and it eases back out. Chapter segments follow the real shape of each song.
intent: Press-to-zoom scrubbing: the waveform magnifies under the pointer so a pixel covers a fraction of a second.
